xmldoc.short_description: Read an XML file as a document object

param_input_item.param_description: a string: path to the XML file.

param_output_item.param_description: an empty placeholder kept for parser compatibility.

description.p: xmlread parses an XML file and returns a Nelson xmlDocument object that can be passed to xmlwrite or xslt.
The object also provides a small DOM-style access layer: getDocumentElement, getElementsByTagName, getTagName, getNodeName, getTextContent, getAttribute, hasAttribute, getLength, and item.
The returned object is not a complete external DOM implementation. The optional second output is currently an empty parser placeholder.

example_item.example_item_description: Read an XML document and access its content with DOM-style methods.
